name: SPD
mechanism: Single target split into disjoint-layer stages. Each cycle advances different token depths. Trained PDM aggregates pre-step target features and overlaps a stage forward. Streaming greedy/rejection verification flushes target KV and intermediates on rejection.
training: Frozen target plus trained PDM/feature projections/LM head. Not allowed training-free Ouro transfer.
devices: H20 servers. n target-stage GPUs plus one dedicated PDM GPU. n8/n16 use9/17ranks across nodes. AR/EAGLE3 use oneH20.
strongest_control: EAGLE3 and PPSD; different resource counts/stacks. Not same-P mixed-depth TP.
timing: Decode tokens/s excluding prefill, batch1. Theoretical alpha*n ignores systems costs. Steady-state phase profiles exclude fill and must not be added to parallel worker timing.
tree_limit: Section4.4 omits branched-tree wall-clock results and leaves branched KV/masks/cross-stage synchronization as future work.

name: SPD
finding: Current implementation v11, archive labeled paper implementation v10, checkpoints not interchangeable, distributed code requires v11. Exact per-paper timing revision provenance remains unresolved. Single-process theoretical timer path can be slower than AR and is not distributed wall-clock evidence.

name: SPD
finding: Layer-range cache shards and global-indexed views. These are ordinary disjoint target-layer stages, not repeated Ouro core replicas.

name: SPD
finding: Rank0 stores proposal distributions, generated-token acceptance, snapshots and pipeline positions. Rejection crops draft KV, purges rejected snapshots/q distributions, and reseeds correction-token embedding.

name: SPD
finding: Wait pending transport before discard, crop local stage shard, clear buffered activations, and preserve an invalid flagged downstream message.

name: SPD
finding: Greedy target argmax check. Sampling uses q_full and normal positive-residual correction except fallback to p when residual_mass<=eps*vocab. The fallback is not universally distribution-preserving.

hypothesis: Unimplemented depth-stationary Ouro verification with full common-core weights per owner and assigned depth-indexed KV.
specific_delta: Can colocate all branches depth-r ancestor KV and avoid tentative KV delivery required by branch-owned replicas.
TP_control: Head-sharded TP already has stationary local KV and can co-batch the same mixed-depth frontier. Do not count saved remote KV reads against it.
ordinary_PP_difference: Disjoint-layer PP shards target weights. Ouro depth stages replicate the common physical core P-fold.
capacity: Balanced depth sharding does not automatically reduce cluster KV relative to balanced head-sharded TP.
adaptive_limit: Original-gate early exit requires exact terminal-copy state at every dependent depth owner. Charge only each receiving owner's missing exact version; local aliases require valid provenance/lifetimes.
not_proven: A new parallel axis or a same-P performance win.

metric: Same-P same-N decode time, matched target/proposals/branch DAG including rejected work and original gate/KV semantics.
accounting_rules: Only disjoint critical-time terms are additive. Do not sum overlapping timers.
Discarded compute enters M, not again G/S.
Do not assume a sign for the compute delta.
Allow each owner all compatible local row batching and allow TP generic prefix attention.
For fully asynchronous schedules use actual event-DAG makespans, not this synchronized-round model. Give TP the same readiness opportunity.
